gloss: clasp purse; coin purse with metal clasp

definitions.gloss: clasp purse; coin purse with metal clasp
definitions.explanation: A small purse with a hinged metal frame and clasp that snaps open like a frog's mouth — the origin of the name. Most commonly used as a coin purse but also made in larger sizes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧がま{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother gave me a clasp purse.

examples.japanese: がま{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I opened the clasp purse and took out some coins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧で、⟦{和柄|わがら}→和柄：29241_wagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かわいい→かわいい：00857_kawaii⟧がま{口|ぐち}{財布|ざいふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: At a shop in Kyoto, I found a cute clasp purse with a Japanese pattern.

notes:
Literally 'toad's mouth' — from ⟦がま→ガマ：28705_gama⟧ (toad) + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth), so named because the metal frame opens like a frog or toad's wide mouth. Often associated with traditional Japanese craft fabrics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- がま{口|ぐち}{財布|ざいふ}: clasp-style wallet
- がま{口|ぐち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a clasp purse
- ⟦{和柄|わがら}→和柄：29241_wagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧がま{口|ぐち}: clasp purse with Japanese pattern

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小銭入|こぜにい}れ→小銭入れ：20896_kozeniire⟧: coin purse (general term)
- ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧: wallet
- ⟦{長財布|ながさいふ}→長財布：27564_nagasaifu⟧: long wallet
